attributes.action: Protect Existing Skilled Workers’ 5-Year ILR Route
attributes.additional_details: Many Skilled Workers came to the UK legally, meeting the required salary, sponsorship and visa conditions. Families paid substantial visa fees and Immigration Health Surcharge and made life-changing decisions based on the five-year settlement pathway. We ask the Government to protect those already on this route from retrospective changes, including their dependent family members, and provide clear transitional arrangements.
attributes.background: We ask the UK Government to protect existing Skilled Workers and their families from retrospective ILR rule changes and allow those already on the five-year settlement pathway to qualify under the rules in place when they came to the UK.

rejection.details: You may wish to sign this petition, which calls for similar action: "Protect the five-year ILR route for existing Skilled Workers" https://petition.parliament.uk/petitions/785621
